title: mentha longifolia var. capensis
intro: Mentha longifolia var. capensis, commonly known as South African pennyroyal, is a plant species belonging to the mint family (Lamiaceae). This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering health benefits such as relief from digestive issues, menstrual cramps, and respiratory problems. The therapeutic actions of South African pennyroyal include spasmolytic, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant effects, which contribute to its use in traditional medicine. The bioactive constituents of Mentha longifolia var. capensis include menthone, limonene, and rosmarinic acid, among others, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
